# TildaZ v0.10.0

**Search your scrollback, click links, and start even when the config is wrong.**

- Search the scrollback of the focused pane. `Cmd+F` / `Ctrl+Shift+F` opens a panel in the
  bottom-right corner; matches are highlighted in place and `Enter` / `Shift+Enter` step
  through them, starting from what is on screen.
  ([#642](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/642))
- Click a link in the terminal to open it in your browser — both OSC 8 hyperlinks and plain
  URLs found on screen. Hold `Ctrl` (`⌘` on macOS) while an app is using the mouse.
  ([#643](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/643))
- A config problem no longer stops TildaZ from starting. Anything it cannot use falls back
  to the default, and a startup notice lists what it changed with a button that opens the
  file. ([#655](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/655))
- Keyboard: `Ctrl+[` sends `ESC` again, `Ctrl+Shift+<letter>` no longer leaks `CSI u` to
  programs that did not ask for it, and Windows `Ctrl+H` / `Shift+Tab` match the other
  platforms. ([#650](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/650),
  [#648](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/648),
  [#653](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/653))

## Upgrade notes

- **A config file from an older version now starts.** Missing keys get defaults, values
  TildaZ cannot read fall back, and a startup notice lists everything it changed — with a
  button that opens the file. Your config is never rewritten; fixing it is up to you.
  ([#655](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/655))
- `[keys]` gained one action (`open_search`). Before this release a missing action stopped
  TildaZ from starting; now it runs on the default binding and the startup notice names it.
  Add the line to silence the notice:

  ```toml
  open_search = ["cmd+f"]        # macOS
  open_search = ["ctrl+shift+f"] # Linux, Windows
  ```

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.10.0-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.10.0-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.10.0-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.10.0-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.10.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.10.0-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.10.0-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.10.0-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
